nehemiah.9.p1.b1.text: On the twenty-fourth day of the same month, the Israelites gathered together, fasting and wearing sackcloth, with dust on their heads.

nehemiah.9.p1.b2.text: … they stood and confessed their sins and the iniquities of their fathers.

nehemiah.9.p1.b3.text: While they stood in their places, they read from the Book of the Law of the LORD their God for a quarter of the day, and they spent another quarter of the day in confession and worship of the LORD their God.

nehemiah.9.p1.b4.text: “Stand up and bless the LORD your God from everlasting to everlasting …

nehemiah.9.p2.b1.text: You alone are the LORD. You created the heavens, the highest heavens with all their host, the earth and all that is on it, the seas and all that is in them. …

nehemiah.9.p2.b2.text: You are the LORD, the God who chose Abram, who brought him out of Ur of the Chaldeans and gave him the name Abraham.

nehemiah.9.p2.b3.text: You found his heart faithful before You, and made a covenant with him … You have kept Your promise, because You are righteous.

nehemiah.9.p3.b1.text: You divided the sea before them, and they crossed through it on dry ground. You hurled their pursuers into the depths like a stone into raging waters.

nehemiah.9.p3.b2.text: You led them with a pillar of cloud by day and a pillar of fire by night, to light for them the way in which they should travel.

nehemiah.9.p3.b3.text: You came down on Mount Sinai and spoke with them from heaven. …

nehemiah.9.p3.b4.text: In their hunger You gave them bread from heaven; in their thirst You brought them water from the rock. …

nehemiah.9.p4.b1.text: Even when they cast for themselves an image of a calf and said, ‘This is your God who brought you up out of Egypt,’ and when they committed terrible blasphemies …

nehemiah.9.p4.b2.text: … But You are a forgiving God, gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and rich in loving devotion, and You did not forsake them.

nehemiah.9.p4.b3.text: For forty years You sustained them in the wilderness, so that they lacked nothing. Their clothes did not wear out and their feet did not swell.

nehemiah.9.p5.b1.text: They captured fortified cities and fertile land … So they ate and were filled; they grew fat and delighted in Your great goodness.

nehemiah.9.p5.b2.text: But they were disobedient and rebelled against You; they flung Your law behind their backs. They killed Your prophets, who had admonished them to return to You. …

nehemiah.9.p5.b3.text: … in their time of distress they cried out to You. From heaven You heard them, and in Your great compassion You gave them deliverers …

nehemiah.9.p5.b4.text: But in Your great compassion, You did not put an end to them; nor did You forsake them, for You are a gracious and compassionate God.

nehemiah.9.p6.b1.text: Its abundant harvest goes to the kings You have set over us because of our sins. … We are in great distress.

nehemiah.9.p6.b3.text: You are just in all that has befallen us, because You have acted faithfully, while we have acted wickedly.

nehemiah.9.p6.b4.text: In view of all this, we make a binding agreement, putting it in writing and sealing it with the names of our leaders, Levites, and priests.”
